issues.description: The problem statement's textual task description (line 50) says to implement addGuestStudents(String), but the UML diagram (line 73) and the reference solution implement addGuestStudents(int). The template's TODO for this method is present but has no signature. This parameter type mismatch (String vs int) in the problem text can confuse students about which parameter type to use and which tests will expect.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the problem statement text to request addGuestStudents(int) (change the misleading 'String' to 'int') so it matches the UML and the intended solution. Alternatively, if the intention was to accept a String, update the UML and solution/template signatures to addGuestStudents(String) and adjust tests accordingly. The preferred fix is to change the textual instruction to int to align with the UML and reference implementation.
